name: devotions-price-cannot-discard-two-click-refused
notes: Devotion's Price (ri955ygd5v, UMBRA spell, reserve 2) has the mandatory additional cost 'discard two cards'. Only ONE other card is in hand, so it cannot be paid. The old post-announce check counted the card that had just been moved onto the effect stack (a stale removed slot) and let the activation continue into a discard prompt listing two slots for a one-card hand; the card sat on the effect stack. Now refused before anything moves.

rulesClauses: As an additional cost to activate Devotion's Price, discard two cards.

engineBug.summary: FIXED (see memory-invocation-no-floating-memory-click-refused). Additionally the old post-announce check counted the just-announced card as still in hand (ZoneSearch returns the removed-but-unspliced slot), so a hand of one other card passed the 'two cards to discard' test and produced a discard prompt over a stale index.
engineBug.verification: Per-step state dump: before the fix EffectStack = [ri955ygd5v] with DQ MZCHOOSE:myHand-0&myHand-1 over a one-card hand; after the fix the card stays in hand and nothing is queued.
